title.line3: I build modern, responsive web experiences.

hero.description: A frontend developer who enjoys shaping thoughtful user interfaces and interactive experiences with React and Next.js — using modern tooling and solid practices to build things that are both beautiful and fast.

about.paragraph1: I'm Ahmadreza, a frontend developer who enjoys designing clean interfaces and interactive experiences. I build sites and apps using current technologies and established best practices — aiming for work that's not only good-looking, but genuinely performant.
about.paragraph2: I care about the details that are easy to skip: consistent spacing, predictable state, components that don't repeat themselves. I'm always picking up new tools and sharpening the ones I already use.

approach.title: A consistent process, applied to every build.

01.title: Understand
01.text: First, I figure out exactly what the interface needs to do, then I focus on how to design and build it.

02.title: Structure
02.text: First, I define the data and component structure so the UI is built on a solid and reliable foundation.

03.title: Build
03.text: I break the work down into small, manageable steps; I separate components early, keep the logic separate from the UI, and keep the styling clean and easy to maintain.

04.title: Refine
04.text: Once the main structure is in place, I focus on the details like spacing, animations, and the little things that make the biggest difference.
